results.name: ime-commit
results.notes: no WM_IME composition started; the real IME did not engage in this run

details.assertion: exactly one new GCS_RESULTSTR-flagged commit segment for the typed pinyin

results.name: ime-segmented
results.notes: segmented commits observed=0 (expected 2); result+preedit same message=False

details.assertion: each of the two commits appears exactly once and carries the GCS_RESULTSTR flag

results.name: ime-cancel
results.notes: no WM_IME composition was observed before Escape

details.assertion: composition started, Escape ended it without a result, no result segment was added, window survived

results.name: ime-focus
results.notes: no WM_IME composition was observed before switching focus

details.assertion: focus loss to our own second window ends the composition without a result and the window stays alive

results.name: ime-resize
results.notes: anchor API round-trip succeeded for each publish point, but the actual on-screen system candidate window position was not independently observed (candidate localization remains UNVERIFIED)

details.assertion: three anchor publishes across resize/move all returned success from ImmSetCandidateWindow and ImmGetCandidateWindow

results.name: latin
results.notes: plain ASCII path with real injected keys under the en-US layout (window-local switch, restored afterwards)

details.keys: abc then 3 injected repeated keydowns for a
details.real_key_repeat_note: SendInput 注入的连续 keydown 被系统合并为一次 WM_KEYDOWN，未能产生自动重复；重复路径由 repeat 场景的合成边界测试覆盖
details.assertion: at least three plain ASCII keys produced GLFW TextInput events and the window-local input language was restored

results.name: repeat
results.notes: synthetic boundary: a posted WM_KEYDOWN with the previous-key-down bit produced GLFW_REPEAT; this is NOT real OS auto-repeat, and real auto-repeat with the IME active remains UNVERIFIED

details.limitation: the repeat notification itself is posted (labelled synthetic) because SendInput cannot produce OS auto-repeat; WM_CHAR duplication is still exercised through TranslateMessage, but the IME's consumption of repeated keys (VK_PROCESSKEY) needs a real physical key check

results.name: nonbmp
results.notes: non-BMP through a synthetic keyboard path (surrogate pair -> single GLFW codepoint) to pin down the GLFW char contract

details.note: synthetic boundary test: not a real IME path, and no WM_IME message was fabricated
details.assertion: exactly one TextInput with a 2-code-unit surrogate pair from the two injected UTF-16 code units

results.name: fault
results.notes: synthetic boundary tests: a managed exception thrown in the native callback and a failing log write were both swallowed; the chained window proc still ran

details.assertion: both injected failures were swallowed at the native callback boundary and the chained proc still ran

results.name: ime-close
results.notes: window was closed while NOT composing (no IME composition started); this only exercises the close/restore boundary and does not verify closing during a composition

status_legend.OBSERVED: message chain / API behaviour observed, but the scenario's end-to-end acceptance semantics were not established
status_legend.UNVERIFIED: input condition missing; nothing was faked
status_legend.FAIL: probe infrastructure failure or assertion violated
